assumptions: The origin tip is resolved as the branch's @{upstream}, falling back to refs/remotes/origin/HEAD; a clone with neither reports cannot-verify rather than comparing against HEAD.
Staleness threshold is 1 day (find -mmin +1440, portable across BSD and GNU find; stat is avoided). A missing FETCH_HEAD is treated as stale.
When the fetch is stale, 4b emits the abstention finding even if the SHA comparison also differs; both findings are reported so a stale clone never reads as a pass.
Check 3 (>14 days) is left unchanged; at >14 days both check 3 and the 4b abstention fire, which is redundant but not wrong.
No network fetch was added to the hook; it stays offline and sub-second as its header promises.
